nom: The Ordinary Rice Lipids + Ectoin Microemulsion Moisturizer

avis.texte: This product is one of the worst things I've ever tried; it is very sticky—my face kept sticking to my pillow and sheets, and it was painful to pull away. When I woke up, I realized my face was burned, very red, and inflamed; my eyes were burning, and my face was in really bad shape after just one day of use.
I've found this to be super hydrating, and not just moisturizing. My skin always feels so amazing and fresh and looks so glowy and healthy!

I cant begin to describe how deeply hydrating yet lightweight this product is. I went too fast with retinoids and damaged my barrier. I tries multiple barrier creams that were seemingly much richer than this, but my skin would still frel irritated and parched part way through the day. Using this as the first product after cleansing and before a thicker cream and then my sunscreen made all the difference. It's amazing. I will use this forever.

I was looking for a lightweight moisturizer for summer heat/humidity but unfortunately this is not it. Feels really nice on skin, interesting milky-serum texture. It is very effective at barrier repair, I used this on sunburned shoulders and it was soothing. But I don't find it moisturizing enough on its own, despite my oily skin I felt the need to use another moisturizer on top which defeated the purpose. I think this works best as a serum before moisturizer (might be great for drier skin types or climates) or a body serum, but for the size there are much more cost effective body serums on the market.

I am definitely going to be buying this one as long as they have it available! It's so good! It's so light and just sinks into my skin. Used as the last layer of my skincare, it just locks everything in. My face feels so plump and moisturized!
Just started using this moisturizer and I love it. has soothed my skin where it has been sore from sweat and humidity. Absorbs well and makes my skin feel plump and soft.

avis.titre: Does work, but broke me out
avis.texte: So it does work, and does hydrate and soften skin. But something in it makes me break out. I know it doesn't do it to everyone. A lot of Drunk Elephant products and Glow Recipe products do that to me. Which I hate, because they seem so nice. Anyways, I mentioned that, incase those products do it to you, this one may break you out as well.

avis.titre: Surprisingly good for eczema prone skin!
avis.texte: Never would i uave thought something so lightweight and thin would be enough to keep my skin moisturized all day. For those who have eczema you know that typically we need a really thick moisturizer to leep our skin from drying out. I've experienced no flaking in the areas that i strugle with consatly such as my nose, eyebrows, mouth, and near my ears. And vest part, I havent had to re apply. It hasnt irritated my skin at all, which is very sinsitive to things like fragrances. I love this product and will continue to use it in my routine!

avis.titre: AMAZING for sensitive, rosacea prone skin
avis.texte: i have struggled to find a good moisturizer that wasn't super costly foreverrrr. they were all either too heavy and left my skin greasy-looking, or they irritated my skin somehow. this is my new holy grail. beautiful skin. i will repurchase forever.
This moisturizer is the best I have ever tried. It has a smooth texture, not heavy on the face and gives it a nice glow/shine. A must try!

avis.titre: 40 year old skin that needed moisture STAT… FIXED!
avis.texte: I am a fan of The Ordinary brand mostly because I've spent the hundreds of bucks on expensive brands… and while they've given me excellent results- who can afford that long term?? I just turned 40 and have sun spots (dark pigmentation), fine lines/wrinkles, and just have an overall dry and dull complexion. Figured I'd give this a try for the price. I HATE thick creams that make me sweat underneath. THIS CREAM IS 100% SMOOTH! It melts into your skin immediately. No residue, no heaviness, no stickiness. Does leave a little tingly feeling on my skin, however, but may be because I first use the Ordinary's Azelaic Acid cream (which I also highly recommend for dark spots). This is a MUST HAVE for mature skin my friends! Oily, dry, acne-prone, doesn't matter! This moisturizer has GOT YOUR BACK!
Love this product! Goes on smooth, makes your skin feel super soft and I've noticed a difference in my skin in just 3 days.
